interface.shortDescription: REEL films and ONCE life stories
interface.longDescription: PlotPickle is an on-demand creative production system guided by Elara in ChatGPT. HOME offers Meet Elara, Learn, Storyboard and Connected Services. Within Storyboard, REEL means make a movie from ideas and screenplays; ONCE means tell a life story, visualize memories and preserve them for family. Both paths use exactly the same underlying PlotPickle story, visual, audio and media tools; ONCE is a gentle conversational framing rather than a separate engine. Storyboard offers Continue Film: a source-pinned Script → Storyboard → Visuals → Produce flow grounded in actual PPF screenplay, shot mappings, selected images, Save/Lock and verified media. The creator chooses when to review, revise and advance. Character and World Builders, Layout Sheets, Assets, Reports, Pitch Deck, Posters, animatic and draft assembly, and the 81-lesson curriculum remain. fal is the preferred external image-to-video provider through the separately installed and authenticated fal ChatGPT plugin, not a bundled API key or embedded MCP server. After confirming a particular source image, eligible model, duration and cost, the user may approve a single job and type Submit to call a connected fal tool, check status and display the returned video in the same chat turn if the job completes and the host supports preview. This is not an unattended background process and does not silently authorize retries. The 1–5 shot 3–15 second Motion Span is editorial timing at 24 fps, not a promise of native generation duration. Test previews from user-supplied composite images are noncanonical until native project bytes and Save/Lock are independently verified. After a completed fal video the in-chat intake attempts verified source-backed 24fps conversion and draft sidecar registration when original video bytes and FFmpeg are accessible; runtime media transport may block and no native PPF import is implied. No automatic cross-chat routing, credential collection, paid generation from an unapproved command, native Save/Lock in an unverified app or finished MP4 is claimed. BUZZ community pilot and Modem remain planned. Editor Phase 1 bundles a portable six-track draft timeline, a local-only Windows media receiver and FFmpeg video verification with undoable edits. ChatGPT cannot yet directly control the Windows process through an installed editor MCP action; the Windows companion must be installed and launched by the creator, and the first browser editor runs locally. Full embedded ChatGPT editing and secure outbound editor tunnel remain unverified. The Windows editor audio phase provides local WAV attachment, synthetic demo ocean/gull cues, gain and mute, exact frame-timed 48 kHz mix, and verified draft playback. These features require the installed local Windows editor and do not establish a live ChatGPT-to-Windows control bridge or native PPF Save/Lock.
